name: Satonaka Kei
source: Kei has a crush on Hashiba-senpai. She is the classmate and best friend of Miho. Kei wants to see romance bloom between Miho and Nasshi and, though the former dislikes it, even tries to force them together at times. [spoiler]As the story progresses, she thinks Miho is trying to steal Hashiba-senpai from her and becomes jealous.[/spoiler]
